verdict.rationale: The product documents board-consent workflows built into grant processes, bulk upload of equity promises, and a Gusto integration that grants equity from offer letters. None of these is a documented programmatic surface (API) an agent could use to draft grants and leave them pending board approval. Probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404. The Gusto sync is a partner integration, not an agent-facing API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft securities (e.g. option grants) via the platform's programmatic surface and leave them queued for human board approval
